results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Article reporting on Fabio Giglietto's study about Meta's political content reduction policy and its impact on Italian parliamentarians' visibility on social media platforms, highlighting how algorithms suppress democratic representatives while extreme content gains traction.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Coverage of Fabio Giglietto's study 'A Pretty Blunt Approach' which investigated the visibility reduction of Italian political representatives on Facebook and Instagram and subsequently led to parliamentary inquiries and journalistic investigations on TV programs like Report on Rai3.
